kernelUnitChecks.scope: Exact reordered convergence at intervals 1/2/4 on both seats; render gate; queued reentrant delivery; closed/error/dispose guards; retained handle accounting and release. Unit fixtures do not replace real-WASM correctness.

decision: Rejected: denser checkpoints cost more; eager interval-4 correction does not repeatedly improve Fountain captured cadence. All experimental runtime/harness/test/contract changes reverted; runtime restored exactly to f0bcaaa.
notRun: Broad every-frame oracle, repeated full-memory correction audits, six-stage and rooms/results suites were not run for this rejected candidate. Existing accepted milestone evidence remains scoped to its original runtime.

limitations: Controls share experimental guards and disabled trace hooks with candidates; they are not untouched-core benchmarks. Native core bytes are unchanged.
Large within-session and cross-session variability; no universal percentage gain or CPU/GPU causal split established.
Short traces use main-thread capture receipt and cannot establish exact draw/capture identity or physical latency.
Eager observed arrival-to-forward lead includes synchronous correction work; it is not spare time.
